summary: Phase 1 Foundation (workspace/company_access/mandates/logs/onboarding) tested end-to-end. Backend 9/9 relevant endpoints pass; qc9434/invoices requires query param (422, not a regression). Frontend: admin login bypasses onboarding (onboarding_complete=true), 'Logs' label replaces 'Journal' (nav-journal), Logs page loads 300 events with 0 errors. All main nav items present (dashboard/budget/acct_dashboard/acct_qc9434), bell + user avatar visible. Company selector correctly shown only on acct_* pages.

minor.issue: Returns 422 without required query param (e.g. company_id). Endpoint exists, no regression.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 6855 lines — should be split into routers/modules (workspace, companies, acct, qc9434, logs, onboarding). Extremely hard to maintain.
Layout.js contains ~470 lines mixing sidebar, header, NotificationsBell, UserMenu, CompanySelector — consider splitting.

Only admin credentials provided; user-level scoping via company_access could not be exercised end-to-end. Recommend seeding a non-admin user with restricted company_access to fully validate the strangler tenancy pattern.

success_rate.backend: 100% of Phase 1 endpoints (9/9 critical, qc9434 422 = param requirement)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 1 tenancy foundation is live. Workspace 'Meelora' (organization_type=company, primary_jurisdiction=CA, onboarding_complete=true). Admin has 2 companies (Meelora + 9434-3977 QC inc.) with company_access role=principal. /api/onboarding correctly returns 400 when complete. /api/mandates=[]. /api/logs returns <=300 items. Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_phase1_foundation.py can be reused. No non-admin user seeded — user-scoping only validated via code review, not runtime.
